name: chart
title: Chart
description: A few numbers as bars, drawn by the stylesheet from a list.
use: A handful of numbers on one scale: a week of days, a ranking of pages. Each item carries its number as --value for the drawing and again as text in chart-value. A line, an area, two series or a time axis need a charting library.

instead.when: It is one figure and how it moved
It is a single reading within a known range
It shows how far one task has come
There are many small numbers and the pattern matters more than each value
The exact numbers are read and compared in several columns

platform.fallback: Bars appear at their full height instead of rising from the baseline

classes.name: chart
classes.description: The list and its plot: bars on a divider, with hairlines at even steps of the scale

classes.name: chart-quiet
classes.description: Tinted bars; the item with aria-current is ink

classes.name: chart-values
classes.description: Every value written over its bar as plain figures, with no pointer needed

classes.name: chart-horizontal
classes.description: Rows for a ranking: the name on a tint as long as the item's share, the figure at the end

classes.name: chart-spark
classes.description: Bars alone, 32px tall and 6px wide; names and values stay in the list for assistive technology

classes.name: chart-item
classes.description: One bar; set --value in its style

classes.name: chart-label
classes.description: The item's name, centered under its bar

classes.name: chart-value
classes.description: The item's number as text: a small tip over the bar, shown while the pointer is on the column

states.name: current
states.description: The bar that is the point of the chart: its name takes strong ink, and in a quiet chart it alone is ink

properties.name: --value
properties.description: The item's number; the stylesheet reads 0 when it is not set

properties.name: --chart-max
properties.description: The top of the scale; a value above it fills the plot

properties.name: --chart-lines
properties.description: Steps of the scale marked by a hairline

example:
1. Mon42
  2. Tue58
